description: Source code implementing PWM signal generation and control logic, including classes for PWM configuration and duty cycle management, with functions for timing, state toggling, and hardware pin control.

classes.name: SimplePwm
classes.description: Class managing simple PWM signal with duty cycle and frequency control.

classes.name: PwmConfig
classes.description: Class representing PWM configuration including timing, mode, and callback management.

methods.name: SimplePwm::setSimplePwmDutyCycle
methods.description: Sets the duty cycle for PWM, adjusting mode accordingly.

methods.description: Sets the PWM frequency by calculating the period.

methods.name: PwmConfig::handleCycleStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a PWM cycle, resetting internal state if needed.

methods.name: PwmConfig::togglePwmState
methods.description: Toggles the PWM signal state and schedules the next toggle.

methods.name: timerCallback
methods.description: Main callback function for PWM timing loop, toggling state and rescheduling.

methods.name: copyPwmParameters
methods.description: Copies PWM parameters into internal structures.

methods.name: PwmConfig::weComplexInit
methods.description: Initializes PWM with complex parameters and starts the PWM cycle.

methods.name: startSimplePwm
methods.description: Starts a simple PWM with specified frequency and duty cycle.

methods.name: startSimplePwmExt

methods.description: Applies the current PWM state to hardware pins.
